topics.topicTitle: Capital Budgeting and Investment Decisions Under Risk and Uncertainty
topics.syllabus: APV, Certainty Equivalent, Sensitivity & Scenario Analysis, Decision Trees, Real Options (Expand, Abandon, Delay), Capital Rationing & Replacement

topics.topicTitle: Cost of Capital and Capital Structure Decisions
topics.syllabus: WACC, CAPM Cost of Equity, Cost of Debt & Preference, MM Proposition I & II (Taxes & Arbitrage), Trade-off Theory, Pecking Order & Indifference Points

topics.topicTitle: Dividend Policy and Working Capital Management
topics.syllabus: Walter's & Gordon's Models, MM Dividend Irrelevance, Lintner Model, Operating Cycle, Baumol & Miller-Orr Cash Models, Factoring & Receivables

topics.topicTitle: Securities Analysis and Portfolio Management, Including CAPM and Modern Portfolio Theory
topics.syllabus: Markowitz Efficient Frontier, Sharpe Single Index Model, CAPM (SML/CML), APT, Portfolio Evaluation (Sharpe, Treynor, Jensen), Bond Duration & Immunization
Stock/Index Futures, Cost of Carry, Hedging with Beta, Binomial & Black-Scholes Models, Put-Call Parity, Greeks & Strategies, Interest Rate Swaps & FRAs

topics.topicTitle: Foreign Exchange Exposure and Risk Management
topics.syllabus: Quotes & Cross Rates, PPP, IRP, Covered Interest Arbitrage, Transaction/Translation/Economic Exposure, Money Market & Forward Hedges, VaR
Home vs Foreign Currency Capital Budgeting, Sovereign Risk, Transfer Pricing, ADRs/GDRs/FCCBs/Masala Bonds, ECBs, Multilateral Netting & DTAA
Swap Ratio (EPS, MPS, Book Value), Post-Merger EPS & MPS, Synergy Valuation, Cash vs Stock Offers, LBOs, Demergers, Slump Sale, Takeover Defenses
Asset-Based NAV, Earnings Capitalization, DCF (FCFF & FCFE, Terminal Value), EV Multiples (EV/EBITDA), EVA, MVA, Brand Valuation & Start-up Valuation
Securitization (PTCs, Tranching), Lease vs Buy (NAL, BELR), Hire Purchase, Merchant Banking, Underwriting Devolvement, VC/PE Valuation & Ratings

topics.topicTitle: Strategic Financial Decision-Making and Financial Modelling
topics.syllabus: Shareholder Value Creation (SVA, Marakon), Sustainable Growth Rate (SGR), Life Cycle Financial Strategy, Altman Z-Score, Financial Modelling & Simulation
